chapters.label: Extra time
chapters.text: Miami, the twenty twenty-four Copa América final, in extra time. Miguel Borja of Colombia is alone in the box. He shoots... Lisandro Martínez slides in from behind and blocks it!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. Borja is a step ahead, but Lisandro keeps chasing. He reads the shot, then slides into its path.

chapters.label: Corner
chapters.text: The ball smacks off his leg and flies out for a corner. Lisandro is only one metre seventy-five!

chapters.label: Be brave
chapters.text: You don't need to be the tallest. Good timing and bravery win duels: keep chasing, pick your moment, be brave!
